rag_knowledge_base.details: TF-IDF based RAG system with real search (no external API). Supports per-agent document upload, background text extraction/chunking, semantic search with scores, and automatic context injection in chat.

endpoints: GET /api/agents/{agent_id}/knowledge - List all docs for agent

rag_chat_injection.details: When user sends message to agent with knowledge docs, backend searches knowledge base and injects relevant context into agent prompt. Verified via backend log: 'RAG: Injected 1 knowledge chunks for agent_legal'

avatar_persistence.details: Assistant messages now include agent_avatar and agent_name fields, preserving the avatar even when viewing past messages

agent_switch_toast.details: toast.success('Switched to {agent.name}') triggers when clicking agent button in chat sidebar

critical_code_review_comments: RAG system uses TF-IDF (sklearn) for search - no external embeddings API needed, making it cost-effective and fast
Document processing runs as async background task - UI polls for status updates
Search threshold is 0.10 (configurable) - low enough to catch relevant results
seed_data_creation: Pre-existing test document 'Bangladesh Income Tax Act 2025' (test_tax_policy.txt) was used for testing. Test uploads were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RAG Knowledge Base system is fully implemented and working: (1) KnowledgeBaseTab.jsx in Admin Dashboard provides per-agent document management, (2) Backend uses TF-IDF (sklearn) for fast search without external APIs, (3) RAG context injection happens in send_message endpoint (~line 2000 in server.py), (4) Avatar persistence: assistant messages include agent_avatar/agent_name fields, (5) Agent switch toast works via toast.success() in AgentChat.jsx

mocked_integrations.note: Third-party integrations (Slack, Airtable, etc.) remain MOCKED. The RAG system is FULLY IMPLEMENTED with real TF-IDF search.

rag_system_architecture.search_algorithm: TF-IDF with cosine similarity (sklearn), ngram_range=(1,2), threshold=0.10
